title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: 2-D compressible perfect-gas conservative equations and reference coefficients documented and implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Separate TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2 multizone sections handled; CGNS MIXED unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Cell-face conservative residual and MPI norms present; low-Mach Rusanov over-dissipation produces large known errors.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov in steady low-Mach produces strong documented dissipation; Roe/entropy-fix transient, no independent shock study.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip, no-slip adiabatic paths; surface output explicitly reports boundary zero velocity.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Weighted least-squares face reconstruction and positivity fallback are source-supported; no independent smooth-order test.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter present; transient loop freezes predictor limiter through inner convergence, without refreshed target recheck.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Tangential skin-friction force projection is implemented; low-Mach laminar forces substantially inaccurate and disclosed.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS present, but M2 laminar residual-only early stop occurs with rapidly evolving drag.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 and predictor-frozen limiter inner iteration implemented; post-refresh target fraction unknown. Delivered segment t600–900, no unsteady rerun.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root preprocessing, METIS owned/ghost and halos; NACA/Re20 np1/2/4/8 final coefficients closely agree, though exact binary hashes unbound.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
